evals.prompt: I have a customer looking to do a pretty large mutation - adding 34 type hints on a JSON column (going from max_dynamic_paths = 0 to pulling out 34 specific key:value pairs). The table has about 2B rows. What does the docs say about mutation behavior on large tables, and does max_dynamic_paths interact with ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN in any special way?
evals.expected_output: Research report with: MCP connectivity check performed, 4+ sub-questions generated, parallel searches executed, documented facts about mutations on large tables, findings about max_dynamic_paths behavior, confidence levels assigned, documentation gaps identified, verification steps provided

assertions.name: mcp-connectivity-check
assertions.text: Output includes evidence that MCP connectivity was checked before research began

assertions.name: sub-questions-generated
assertions.text: At least 4 distinct sub-questions were generated from the original question

assertions.name: source-tags-present
assertions.text: Every finding has a source tag (MCP / Web / General) and a URL where applicable

assertions.name: confidence-levels
assertions.text: Findings are categorized into Documented (high), Inferred (medium), and Gaps (unknown)

assertions.name: documentation-gaps-identified
assertions.text: At least one documentation gap is explicitly called out

assertions.name: verification-steps
assertions.text: Output includes concrete verification steps the customer can take

assertions.name: no-em-dashes
assertions.text: Output contains no em dash characters

evals.prompt: A customer on ClickHouse Cloud is trying to connect their MSK (Managed Streaming for Kafka) cluster in AWS ca-central-1 to ClickHouse Cloud. They're getting connection timeouts. What are the networking options - egress IPs, VPC endpoints, PrivateLink? What does the docs say about AWS region compatibility?
evals.expected_output: Research report covering: Cloud networking options (egress IPs, Private Link, VPC endpoints), AWS region-specific documentation, MSK-specific connectivity guidance, version requirements if any, with clear source attribution

assertions.name: mcp-connectivity-check
assertions.text: Output includes evidence that MCP connectivity was checked before research began

assertions.name: parallel-searches
assertions.text: Sub-questions table shows results counts for each query, indicating parallel execution

assertions.name: networking-options-covered
assertions.text: Output covers at least 2 of: egress IPs, PrivateLink, VPC endpoints

assertions.name: source-status-table
assertions.text: Output includes a Source Status table showing which sources were used (MCP/Web/General)

assertions.name: urls-provided
assertions.text: At least 2 documentation URLs are included in the findings

assertions.name: answer-with-confidence
assertions.text: Final answer section includes an explicit confidence level (High/Medium/Low)
